title: T011 — incompatible or unknown conversion target
purpose: Passing an unrecognized unit to a conversion verb fails the field.
trigger: %distance is given the unit "parsecs", which is not a supported distance unit.
notes: Reported as a T011 error: 'Incompatible conversion in 'distance': unknown unit 'parsecs' (expected 'km', 'mi', or 'miles')'.
%dateDiff with an unknown unit (e.g. "fortnights") raises the same T011.
